messages:
Riley: Noticed a couple small but annoying things in the compact toolbar on the console page at <= 480px: ghost buttons feel squeezed and the segmented control labels wrap awkwardly. Screenshot + quick GIF attached.
Ana: Yeah that area is tight. Which controls are wrapping? The view toggle and the timestamp selector?
Riley: Exactly. View toggle (list/grid) and the quick filter chip group. Also the primary ghost button's visible icon is 24px but the hit area is only 28px so its easy to miss on touch.
Marcus: We should standardize hit areas to a token so mobile + desktop match. Propose alias `control-hit` -> `spacing-10` (44px target) for touch, but for the compact toolbar we can use `control-hit-compact` -> `spacing-08` (36px).
June: Caution on too many tokens. Maybe one token `control-hit` that resolves responsively (44px on touch breakpoints, 36px on dense desktop). That keeps the token set smaller.
Ana: I like responsive token idea. Implementation detail: will the CSS use clamp() or media queries? Media queries are clearer for the design system docs.
Marcus: Media queries + token mapping in the token JSON. Also we should avoid changing visible icon size; keep icons at 20/24px but increase invisible padding. Example CSS snippet I can PR:
```
.icon-btn { padding: calc((var(--control-hit) - var(--icon-size)) / 2); }
```
June: Accessibility: ensure focus outline does not get clipped by the compact toolbar container. I hit a case where focused ghost button rendered the ring outside but the overflow hidden clipped it.
Riley: Good catch. The toolbar uses `overflow: hidden` to crop dropdown shadows. We should preserve clipping for shadows but allow focus rings via `outline-offset` or move focus ring to an inner element.
Marcus: Or render focus ring using box-shadow on an inner pseudo element that sits inside the clipping context. Another approach: ensure toolbar container doesn't set `overflow: hidden` when focusable children receive focus. But thats fiddly. Prefer the pseudo-element approach.
Ana: Also microcopy: the tooltip for the view toggle currently says "Toggle view". Can we make it clearer: "Toggle view: List / Grid"? Short but explicit. For the timestamp selector tooltip change "Auto" to "Auto (local timezone)" to avoid confusion.
June: Small accessibility improvement: segmented control needs aria-pressed states and the active segment should have `aria-current="true"` and not rely solely on color. Add visually-hidden text that reads the selected state.
Riley: Good. Also proposal for the segmented control wrap: when labels would wrap, switch to icon-only mode with accessible labels in a collapsed menu. This keeps the toolbar height consistent.
Marcus: Implementation plan: 1) Add responsive `control-hit` token, 2) update CSS to use padding calc, 3) render focus ring via pseudo-element to avoid clipping, 4) collapsed icon-only fallback for segmented control at <= 420px, 5) microcopy updates for tooltips.
Ana: I'll handle copy updates and docs. June, can you own the a11y checks (NVDA + VoiceOver) and confirm aria attributes?
June: On it. I'll also test keyboard focus in the clipped toolbar scenario.
DesignBot: New PR #4677 opened: "compact-toolbar: responsive hit tokens, focus ring fix, collapsed-segments". CI: visual tests added for 360/420/768.
Marcus: I'll land the CSS + token JSON. Will include screenshots and unit test for focus clipping. ETA tomorrow morning.
Riley: Thanks team. Please paste the staging link when PR is deployed. Small follow-up: let's avoid adding token names that include component names (e.g., resizer-hit) unless absolutely necessary. Use generic names with responsive values so tokens are reusable.
Ana: Agreed. I'll update the tokens.md note in the PR to reflect that guidance.
DesignBot: Reminder: tokens.md has a convention section; please add `control-hit` in the responsive examples.
Riley: Awesome. :thumbsup:
